evidence_excerpts: A photoelectric detection event at either detector projects the ensembles into |ΨL,R⟩ = 1/√2 [|0a⟩L|1a⟩R ± eiη1|1a⟩L|0a⟩R].
Detection of a photon from one or the other atomic ensemble in an indistinguishable fashion results in an entangled state with one collective spin excitation shared coherently between the ensembles.
text: The DLCZ protocol creates heralded entanglement between atomic ensembles by interfering emitted single-photon fields and conditioning on a detector event.
